reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 06 and targeted source panel, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution face/collar crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

entries.positive_observation: The dark olive peaked cap, gold front details and gold-trimmed dark visor remain, with covered hair and dark eyebrows. One distinct narrow dark upper-lip moustache remains above a single firm closed mouth; the chin and jaw are smooth without a beard, and no glasses were added. The near-frontal capped head tilts subtly toward viewer left, with a slightly left gaze, chest-up crop, warm directional facial light and deep visor shadow. The dark olive-brown uniform retains two red-and-gold collar patches, partly visible shoulder trim, one narrow pale/red neck ribbon and one small gold-toned pendant. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a long stalk, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted dark frame, darker opaque muted gray-olive photographic backing, overlapping warm-cream note with two compact upper gray-mark rows and mostly blank lower paper, and small right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte outer ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection found no visible holes or missing backing; 252-254 alpha values were not used as a rejection shortcut. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: At 65x67 the exact cap/collar symbols and small ribbon/pendant construction cannot be transcribed, and the note glyphs are indistinct; visible colors, placements, counts and two-row upper-note footprint were checked without claiming microscopic identity.
